findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut help menu — bulk actions require mouse

findings.issue: Avatar image uses instead of Next.js — no lazy loading or responsive images

findings.issue: All messages stored in single flat array — no pagination, windowing, or pruning of old messages

findings.issue: Search UI shows flat results with no date range or channel filter controls

findings.issue: No search performance benchmarks — no baseline for tsvector query latency under load

findings.issue: governance.yml and platform.yml workflows are broken on every push — call run_full.ps1 referencing 5 nonexistent scripts

findings.fix: Choose enhanced-textarea architecture (TipTap/ProseMirror for rich editing, or textarea with overlay components for simpler approach); implement markdown preview, slash commands, and keyboard shortcuts

findings.issue: No mention/channel autocomplete popover — @ and # triggers have no suggestion UI
findings.impact: Users must type exact @usernames and #channel-slugs from memory; no discoverability
findings.fix: Implement @mention popover: trigger on @keypress, debounced user search across workspace members, keyboard navigation (arrow keys + Enter), multi-word display names with avatar. Same pattern for #channel autocomplete.

findings.issue: File upload is a separate API call with no inline drag-drop or paste support in message input
findings.impact: Users must use separate upload UI; no inline image pasting or drag-drop from desktop
findings.fix: Implement drag-drop zone on message input area, paste event handler for images, upload progress indicator in compose bar, attachment preview pills before send

findings.issue: No emoji picker in message input — users cannot add emoji to messages from compose UI
findings.impact: Emoji usage requires typing :emoji_name: manually or using separate emoji picker for reactions only
findings.fix: Integrate emoji-mart or custom emoji picker: trigger on :keypress or toolbar button, frequently used/recent emoji section, search/filter

findings.issue: Rich editor risks breaking keyboard accessibility — arrow keys, Enter, and Escape in autocomplete must not interfere with normal text editing
findings.impact: Keyboard users may be unable to type @ or # characters normally, or autocomplete may trap focus
findings.fix: Ensure keyboard navigation: Escape closes autocomplete without selecting, Backspace on empty mention removes mention chip, Enter selects without submitting form

findings.issue: No tests for paste, drag-drop, emoji, or mention interaction flows
findings.impact: Rich editor UX changes will ship without regression coverage
findings.fix: Write Playwright tests: paste image creates upload, drag-drop file shows preview, @mention selects user, emoji picker inserts emoji

findings.issue: No @mention parsing at message creation time — no detection of @user, @role, @everyone, @here patterns
findings.impact: Mention-driven notifications are completely absent; users cannot @mention each other
findings.fix: Implement mention parser that runs at message create: extract @username patterns, resolve to user IDs, validate membership, create notification records

findings.issue: No offline notification queue — notifications created only for currently connected users via in-memory operations
findings.impact: Offline users miss notifications; no persistent inbox for missed @mentions or thread replies
findings.fix: Create notification_queue table: all notifications persisted on send; delivered via push/websocket on user reconnect

findings.issue: No notification_preferences table — users cannot control which notifications they receive per channel or per type
findings.impact: Every notification goes to every workspace member; no mute, no channel-level suppression
findings.fix: Create notification_preferences: user_id FK, workspace_id FK (null=global), channel_id FK (null), notification_type TEXT, enabled BOOLEAN. Set sensible defaults.

findings.issue: No @role or @everyone mention support — mention system must resolve role members and workspace members
findings.impact: Broadcast mentions (@everyone, @channel) and role-targeted mentions (@admin, @moderator) not possible
findings.fix: Extend mention parser: @everyone resolves to all workspace members, @role resolves to workspace_members with that role

findings.issue: No mention autocomplete UI in message input — users must type @username manually with no suggestion dropdown
findings.impact: Mention discoverability is poor; users must know exact usernames
findings.fix: Implement @mention autocomplete popover: debounced search, keyboard-navigable list, multi-word display names

findings.issue: No channel muting or notification suppression rules — channel level mute/unmute not supported
findings.impact: Users cannot mute noisy channels; notification fatigue
findings.fix: Add channel mute flag to notification_preferences; filter notifications at delivery time based on mute rules

findings.issue: Notification bell shows count but no distinction between mention types (@user vs @everyone vs thread reply)
findings.impact: Users cannot prioritize notifications; all notification types visually identical
findings.fix: Add notification type icons/coloring: @mention highlight, thread reply indicator, @everyone warning style

findings.issue: No abuse/edge-case tests for mentions: self-mention, mention of non-member, @everyone spam, mention flood
findings.impact: Mention system vulnerable to abuse without rate limiting or validation
findings.fix: Add mention rate limiting (max 10 @mentions per message), self-mention check, non-member validation; write tests

findings.issue: No application-level alerting configured — no error rate, latency, auth failure, or health check alerts
findings.impact: Production incidents detected only when users report them — no proactive notification of system degradation
findings.fix: Configure Sentry alert rules for error threshold breaches and PagerDuty/Slack integration; add Prometheus alert rules

findings.issue: No external uptime monitoring service configured — no Pingdom, Checkly, Better Uptime, or UptimeRobot
findings.impact: Complete downtime is only detected when users report it or Docker HEALTHCHECK notices locally — no external view
findings.fix: Add free-tier uptime monitoring (UptimeRobot or Better Uptime) that checks /healthz every 5 minutes

findings.issue: DigitalOcean alerts (CPU>80%, Memory>80%, Disk>90%) only go to email — no PagerDuty, Slack, or SMS integration
findings.impact: Critical infrastructure alerts may be missed if email notifications are not monitored promptly
findings.fix: Add Slack webhook or PagerDuty integration to DO monitoring alerts

findings.issue: No automatic request logging middleware — every log line must include request context manually
findings.impact: Inconsistent log context; some requests produce no access log; correlation requires manual context passing
findings.fix: Add auto-request-logging middleware that captures method, path, status code, duration, and request ID for every request

findings.issue: No distributed tracing — only basic request IDs, no OpenTelemetry, span propagation, or trace correlation across services
findings.impact: Cannot trace a single user action across API -> DB -> WebSocket -> webhook; debugging complex failures requires manual log correlation
findings.fix: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation for Express, database queries, and external HTTP calls

findings.issue: No log shipping or aggregation — logs are local Docker container stdout; no Papertrail, Logtail, Axiom, or Loki
findings.impact: No centralized log search; logs lost on container restart; cannot alert on log patterns
findings.fix: Add Docker log driver to send logs to a cloud log aggregation service; or add logagent sidecar

findings.issue: 18 Prometheus metrics exposed but no remote collector, dashboard, or alert rules consume them
findings.impact: Metrics are generated and exposed but never visualized or alerted on — observability gap
findings.fix: Set up Grafana dashboard consuming API /metrics endpoint; define alert rules for error rate and latency

findings.issue: Frontend has no structured logging — console.log/error used ad-hoc
findings.impact: Client-side issues cannot be diagnosed from logs; no structured frontend telemetry
findings.fix: Add frontend logging library (e.g., loglevel) with remote log shipping for production errors

findings.issue: Audit event queue is in-memory — lost on process restart; no Redis-backed persistence
findings.impact: Audit events during restart window are lost; compliance gap for sensitive operations
findings.fix: Replace in-memory queue with Redis-backed persistent queue or write directly with retry

findings.issue: Health checks only validate database connectivity — no check for Redis, Supabase Storage, or external service availability
findings.impact: Health check can pass while critical dependencies (Redis, Storage) are down
findings.fix: Add dependency checks for Redis (if configured), Supabase Storage connectivity, and circuit breaker states

findings.issue: No business metrics dashboard — active users, messages/day, workspace growth not visualized anywhere
findings.impact: Business stakeholders lack visibility into platform growth and adoption
findings.fix: Create Grafana dashboard with business metrics: daily active users, messages/day, workspaces created, reactions

findings.issue: No audit event for read operations (SELECT queries) — only mutation events are logged
findings.impact: Unauthorized read access to sensitive data leaves no audit trail
findings.fix: Add audit logging for read operations on sensitive data (user search, workspace member list, audit log views)

findings.issue: Message sending is synchronous — waits for API response before showing message in list
findings.impact: Noticeable delay between pressing Send and message appearing; chat feels sluggish
findings.fix: Implement optimistic send: generate temporary UUID, add message to state immediately with 'sending' flag, replace ID on server confirmation, show retry on failure

findings.issue: No temporary entity ID strategy — message, reaction, and edit operations all use real IDs from server
findings.impact: Cannot perform optimistic updates without knowing the final ID; delays all mutation feedback
findings.fix: Create temporary ID generation strategy (crypto.randomUUID()); map temp IDs to server IDs on confirmation; reconcile state

findings.issue: No rollback visual feedback — when optimistic update fails, user sees no error indication or retry mechanism
findings.impact: Failed sends silently disappear; users must retype messages
findings.fix: Show failed message inline with 'Failed to send — tap to retry' banner; preserve message content in local draft on failure

findings.issue: No deduplication strategy for server echoes — when server confirms via WebSocket, optimistic message may duplicate
findings.impact: Duplicate messages appear when server echoes back the same message that was optimistically inserted
findings.fix: Use temporary UUID as dedup key: on receiving socket message:new, check if temp ID exists in state; if yes, replace with server data; if no, insert as new

findings.issue: Reactions, edits, and deletes are not in optimistic UI scope — only message sends considered
findings.impact: Partial optimistic coverage; reaction and edit feedback still delayed
findings.fix: Extend optimistic engine: optimistic reaction toggle (immediate visual change, revert on failure), optimistic edit (immediate update, revert on server reject)

findings.issue: TypeScript types are severely out of sync with DB schema — 6 types defined vs 16 tables exist; soft-delete fields missing
findings.impact: Feature expansion will produce type errors across all packages; developers forced to use 'any'
findings.fix: Run supabase gen types typescript --local > packages/db/src/types.ts before starting feature implementation; add CI check for type-schema drift

findings.issue: No background job infrastructure — no job queue (Bull/BullMQ), no worker process, no scheduled task framework
findings.impact: Notification fanout, webhook delivery retry, search indexing, and media processing all require async workers; current architecture handles these synchronously or not at all
findings.fix: Design job queue abstraction: Redis-backed BullMQ for Node.js, worker process pattern (apps/worker/), job retry/DLQ handling, scheduled job support for retention/pruning

findings.issue: API versioning uses /v1/ prefix but no version negotiation headers (Accept-version, Sunset, Deprecation)
findings.impact: Expanding API for new features cannot gracefully deprecate old endpoints; breaking changes affect all clients
findings.fix: Implement version negotiation: Accept-Version header support, Deprecation/Sunset headers on old versions, version migration guide in docs

findings.issue: No down/rollback scripts for any existing 26 migrations — feature expansion adds more migrations without rollback capability
findings.impact: Schema changes for 11 new features will compound the rollback problem; forward-fix becomes only option
findings.fix: Write down scripts for existing ALTER TABLE migrations (#14-16); mandate down scripts for all future migrations

findings.issue: No business analytics or feature usage tracking — cannot measure adoption of new features
findings.impact: Cannot determine whether feature investments (threads, mentions, search) are being used or are having impact
findings.fix: Add feature usage tracking: create feature_events table (event_type TEXT, user_id, metadata JSONB); instrument feature entry points; create adoption dashboard

findings.issue: No realtime event naming convention or registry — socket events are ad-hoc in service files
findings.impact: New feature realtime events will have inconsistent naming; clients must reverse-engineer event payloads
findings.fix: Create realtime event registry (TypeScript enum or const object) in packages/realtime/ with typed payloads for all events

findings.issue: No API contract validation between frontend and backend — types are duplicated or manually maintained
findings.impact: Frontend/backend contract drift for new features will cause silent production failures
findings.fix: Create packages/contract/ with shared API request/response types shared between apps/api and apps/web; add JSON Schema validation or use tRPC

findings.issue: Feature flags exist in DB but are not wired to code — cannot dark-launch new features
findings.impact: New features must be deployed all-at-once; no gradual rollout or kill-switch capability
findings.fix: Wire featureFlagService.evaluateFlag() into feature boundaries before implementing new features; set up flag evaluation in frontend via API

findings.issue: No channel-level permission override model — all channel access is binary (member of workspace = can see all public channels)
findings.impact: Cannot restrict specific channels to specific roles; hidden/staff-only channels impossible
findings.fix: Design permission matrix: workspace roles (Admin, Moderator, Member, Guest) + channel overrides (allow/deny per role or per user). Precedence: explicit deny > explicit allow > workspace role default.

findings.issue: No channel_role_overrides table — cannot define per-role or per-user channel access exceptions
findings.impact: Channel-level access control requires new database table plus RLS changes
findings.fix: Create channel_role_overrides: channel_id FK, role TEXT (or user_id UUID nullable), permission TEXT (allow/deny), scope TEXT (read/write/admin). Unique (channel_id, role) or (channel_id, user_id)

findings.issue: Current RLS policies for channels and messages are binary — workspace member sees all public channels. No override resolution logic.
findings.impact: RLS must be updated to consider channel_role_overrides for hidden channels and restricted content
findings.fix: Update channel SELECT RLS: if channel has override restricting role=user_role, exclude from results. Add admin-bypass policy for workspace admins.

findings.issue: No channel settings UI for managing role overrides — cannot configure channel permissions from frontend
findings.impact: Channel permission management requires direct DB access or API calls
findings.fix: Add channel settings page with members tab showing current role assignments and override controls (channel admin only)

findings.issue: Channel access middleware checks workspace membership but not channel-level role overrides
findings.impact: Middleware bypasses channel-level permissions; overrides only enforced at RLS level (bypassable if service_role client used)
findings.fix: Add channel_role_override check to requireChannelAccess middleware: if user has explicit deny on channel, return 403

findings.issue: No privilege escalation or hidden-channel leakage tests
findings.impact: RBAC changes risk introducing authorization bypasses without detection
findings.fix: Write test cases: user without channel override cannot access channel, user with explicit deny gets 403, admin bypasses overrides, hidden channel not in list

findings.issue: Production deploy runs docker system prune -af --volumes and docker image prune -af before health check succeeds
findings.impact: Previous SHA-tagged images (needed for rollback) are destroyed before the current deploy is verified. If deploy fails, there is nothing to roll back to.
findings.fix: Move docker prune steps to AFTER successful health check; or use timestamp-based pruning that preserves at least the previous release's SHA images

findings.issue: Rollback job has needs: build-images — triggers unnecessary image build before rollback can execute
findings.impact: Rollback delayed by 20+ minutes (unnecessary image build) while production is degraded
findings.fix: Change rollback job needs to [provision] only — rollback pulls existing SHA images without building new ones

findings.issue: Production version badge build-args (NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME) not passed
findings.impact: Production always shows 'v0.0.0-dev' and 'local' — operators cannot identify which version is running without inspecting GHCR tags
findings.fix: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.run_number }}, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME build-args to web Docker build step

findings.issue: No database down/rollback scripts exist for any of the 26 migrations
findings.impact: Forward-fix is the only path for migration issues; PITR causes data loss for the entire database
findings.fix: Write down scripts (.down.sql) for each migration, starting with the 5 ALTER TABLE migrations (#14, #15, #16) that add columns

findings.issue: No rollback job exists for development environment — always deploys latest origin/develop
findings.impact: Broken develop deploy requires manual SSH intervention; no automated recovery path
findings.fix: Add workflow_dispatch with rollback_sha input to deploy-development.yml matching production pattern

findings.issue: Feature flags exist in database but are not wired to any application code — 5 seed flags control nothing
findings.impact: In an emergency, there is no kill-switch mechanism to disable features (push notifications, realtime, file upload)
findings.fix: Audit all feature boundaries and add featureFlagService.evaluateFlag() checks; implement global kill-switch flag

findings.issue: Post-rollback validation only checks /healthz HTTP 200 — no functional smoke tests
findings.impact: Rollback can pass health check while critical features (auth, messaging, realtime) are still broken
findings.fix: Add smoke-test step after rollback: send test message via API, verify WebSocket connect, check auth flow

findings.issue: Migration rollback runbook incorrectly states PostgreSQL does not support DDL rollback
findings.impact: Operators may not attempt safe DDL rollback (BEGIN; ... ROLLBACK;) thinking it's impossible
findings.fix: Correct the runbook: PostgreSQL fully supports DDL rollback within transaction blocks

findings.issue: Development deploy runbook has no rollback section at all
findings.impact: Operators lack documented recovery steps for failed development deployments
findings.fix: Add rollback section to development-deploy-overview.md referencing the production rollback pattern

findings.issue: Circuit breaker implemented but not wired to any feature flag or kill-switch
findings.impact: Circuit breaker opens silently on external dependency failure but no kill-switch mechanism exists to manually disable the failing integration
findings.fix: Wire circuit breaker state to feature flag evaluation so operators can manually disable failing integrations

findings.issue: No git tags or semver releases — only git SHAs identify releases
findings.impact: Cannot easily reference known-good states; no release notes; git describe falls back to bare SHA
findings.fix: Add git tag (e.g., vYYYYMMDD-runNumber) at end of deploy-production.yml; create release notes

findings.issue: Rollback readiness checklists exist in docs/ but are not referenced by any workflow or runbook
findings.impact: Checklists are undiscoverable during incident response
findings.fix: Reference rollback_readiness_checklist.md from production-deploy-overview.md and incident-response.md

findings.issue: No auth on users route
findings.impact: Full data access
findings.fix: Add requireAuth

findings.issue: Users search endpoint missing requireOrgAccess
findings.impact: Authenticated users can search across all tenants
findings.fix: Add requireOrgAccess middleware to search route

findings.issue: CSP missing frame-ancestors directive
findings.impact: Clickjacking risk on all pages
findings.fix: Add frame-ancestors 'self' to CSP header

findings.issue: Magic link email not normalized before send
findings.impact: user@Example.com and user@example.com treated differently
findings.fix: Lowercase email before sending magic link

findings.issue: /metrics endpoint is completely unauthenticated — exposes request counts, durations, WS connections, DB query durations
findings.impact: Anyone can access internal metrics — information disclosure of system topology, traffic patterns, and performance data
findings.fix: Add authenticate middleware to /metrics route or restrict to internal network

findings.issue: Reaction service uses getSupabase() (anon client) — bypasses RLS entirely for all reaction CRUD
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can add/remove reactions on any message in any workspace — no tenant isolation
findings.fix: Replace getSupabase() with req.supabase (JWT client) in reactions/service.ts for all operations

findings.issue: 4 SECURITY DEFINER functions missing SET search_path — search_path injection vulnerability
findings.impact: User with CREATE privilege can create malicious objects that hijack these functions' elevated privileges
findings.fix: Add SET search_path = 'public' to all SECURITY DEFINER function definitions

findings.issue: Message search uses getSupabase() (anon client) — auth.uid() is NULL in SECURITY INVOKER search function
findings.impact: Search function cannot verify user membership — cross-tenant data leakage or no results returned
findings.fix: Replace getSupabase() with req.supabase on messages/routes.ts line 38

findings.issue: Webhook HMAC signature uses JSON.stringify with non-deterministic property ordering
findings.impact: Receivers cannot verify the HMAC signature as JSON.stringify property order is not guaranteed
findings.fix: Use a deterministic serialization method (e.g., object key sorting) before HMAC computation

findings.issue: CI/CD secrets written to disk via inline echo commands — GitHub Actions masking can fail
findings.impact: If shell fails in specific ways, secrets (origin TLS cert, private key, etc.) could appear in logs
findings.fix: Use GitHub Actions environment file ($GITHUB_ENV) or secret files instead of echo; or use docker secret injection

findings.issue: Workspace member management (add/remove/update role) lacks admin/owner role check — any member can manage members
findings.impact: Any workspace member can add, remove, or change roles of other members — privilege escalation
findings.fix: Add admin/owner role check in POST/PATCH/DELETE workspace member routes

findings.issue: Webhook secret stored in plaintext in database and returned in API responses to all workspace members
findings.impact: Workspace members can read webhook secrets — if a webhook is used for CI/CD triggers, full CI pipeline access
findings.fix: Encrypt webhook secret at rest (pgcrypto); mask secret in API responses

findings.issue: Socket.io has allowEIO3: true enabling Engine.IO v3 legacy protocol
findings.impact: Expanded attack surface — Engine.IO v3 has known vulnerabilities and fewer security features
findings.fix: Set allowEIO3: false unless backward compatibility is required

findings.issue: Auth redirect URL uses window.location.origin without validation or allowlist
findings.impact: Open redirect vulnerability — attacker could craft a login URL that redirects to a malicious site after auth
findings.fix: Validate redirectTo against an allowlist of known origins before using

findings.issue: isWorkspaceMember helper uses getSupabase() (anon client) without user JWT context
findings.impact: Membership check bypasses RLS — could return incorrect results or be bypassed
findings.fix: Pass per-request Supabase client to isWorkspaceMember instead of using global anon client

findings.issue: User email logged in workspace list operations — PII exposure in logs
findings.impact: User email addresses exposed in structured logs — potential PII breach in log aggregation
findings.fix: Remove userEmail from log metadata; log only userId where needed

findings.issue: Auth and search rate limiters key by IP only — not user+IP composite
findings.impact: Multiple users behind same NAT share rate limit bucket; single attacker with rotating IPs bypasses limits
findings.fix: Use composite key {userId + ip} when user is authenticated, fall back to IP only for unauthenticated

findings.issue: CSP includes 'unsafe-inline' for styles and allows cdn.jsdelivr.net for scripts
findings.impact: Inline styles enable CSS-based data exfiltration; jsdelivr CDN allows any script from that domain
findings.fix: Use nonce-based CSP for inline styles; restrict CDN allowlist to specific known script paths

findings.issue: CSRF cookie has httpOnly: false (by design for SPA) — any XSS can exfiltrate the token
findings.impact: If XSS is present, CSRF protection is completely bypassed
findings.fix: Consider additional CSRF measures like origin/referer header checking alongside double-submit cookie

findings.issue: No Socket.io rate limiting — channel:join, typing:start/stop events not rate-limited
findings.impact: Malicious client can flood server with socket events, impacting all users
findings.fix: Add per-socket rate limiting for chat events (e.g., max 10 typing events per 5 seconds)

findings.issue: Avatar upload and retrieval routes use getSupabase() (anon client) — storage RLS bypassed
findings.impact: Storage operations may not have proper RLS context — potential unauthorized access
findings.fix: Use getSupabaseAdmin() for avatar upload, req.supabase for avatar retrieval

findings.issue: Feature flag service uses getSupabaseAdmin() for all operations including reads
findings.impact: Regular users cannot be prevented from accessing feature flags at DB level — overprivileged reads
findings.fix: Use req.supabase for reads, getSupabaseAdmin() only for writes

findings.issue: GDPR delete does not clean up audit_logs or consent_logs for the deleted user
findings.impact: User's audit trail and consent records remain after GDPR deletion request — compliance gap
findings.fix: Add cascade or explicit deletion of audit_logs and consent_logs in the GDPR delete endpoint

findings.issue: Trivy vulnerability scanner uses @master tag — mutable reference
findings.impact: Supply chain risk — unpinned action version could introduce breaking changes or malicious code
findings.fix: Pin trivy-action to a specific SHA or semver tag

findings.issue: CSP lacks nonce-based protection for inline scripts
findings.impact: Any injected <script> tag executes in older browsers without CSP enforcement
findings.fix: Implement nonce-based CSP for inline script tags

findings.issue: wget installed in production Docker image — unnecessary package increases attack surface
findings.impact: Extra package in runtime image could be used as attack vector
findings.fix: Remove wget from production Dockerfile; use curl or built-in health check mechanism

findings.issue: console.error in auth callback exposes errors client-side in browser console
findings.impact: Auth errors visible to end users in browser dev tools
findings.fix: Replace console.error with silent logging or Sentry capture

findings.issue: No webhook event type allowlist — any event string accepted
findings.impact: Invalid or unexpected event types could trigger webhooks unnecessarily
findings.fix: Add Zod enum validation for supported event types

findings.issue: pnpm audit threshold set to moderate — high/critical advisories below threshold won't block CI
findings.impact: High-severity dependency vulnerabilities may not block deployment
findings.fix: Raise pnpm audit threshold to high to at minimum block high-severity issues

findings.issue: No thread_metadata table — reply_count, participant_count, last_activity_at, view_count not tracked
findings.impact: Thread list cannot show reply counts, sort by activity, or track participant engagement
findings.fix: Create thread_metadata table: id (PK = message_id), reply_count INT DEFAULT 0, participant_count INT DEFAULT 0, last_activity_at TIMESTAMPTZ, view_count INT DEFAULT 0

findings.issue: Thread panel has no thread participant tracking, no join/leave semantics, no thread unread counts, no participant list
findings.impact: Thread UX is basic — users cannot see who is in a thread or control thread participation
findings.fix: Add thread participants sidebar, join/leave buttons, thread unread badge, participant count display

findings.issue: No thread_participants table — cannot track who has joined/left a thread for notification routing
findings.impact: Thread notifications must go to all workspace members instead of thread participants only
findings.fix: Create thread_participants table: thread_id FK, user_id FK, joined_at, last_read_at TIMESTAMPTZ. Unique (thread_id, user_id)

findings.issue: No thread-specific API endpoints — no get thread participants, join thread, leave thread, get thread unread count
findings.impact: Frontend cannot manage thread participation or display thread-specific state
findings.fix: Add API endpoints: GET /threads/:id, POST /threads/:id/join, POST /threads/:id/leave, GET /threads/:id/unread

findings.issue: No thread-specific realtime events — thread:reply, thread:participant_joined, thread:participant_left
findings.impact: Thread updates not pushed in real-time; clients must poll
findings.fix: Add socket events: thread:reply (with parent context), thread:participant_joined, thread:participant_left

findings.issue: No thread indicator on messages that have threads — no reply count badge, no thread preview
findings.impact: Users cannot see which messages have active threads without clicking each one
findings.fix: Add thread reply count badge, last reply preview text, and click-to-open-thread on message

findings.issue: No thread-specific tests — no E2E for thread creation, reply, join/leave, unread counts, realtime sync
findings.impact: Thread feature will ship without automated regression coverage
findings.fix: Write tests: create thread via reply API, fetch thread participants, join/leave, verify unread counts, verify realtime events

findings.issue: No visual regression testing tooling of any kind installed — no Percy, Chromatic, Playwright snapshots, or Applitools
findings.impact: UI regressions reach production undetected — every deploy risks visual breakage with zero automated detection
findings.fix: Install Playwright's built-in visual comparison (await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot()) — no extra dependencies needed

findings.issue: No screenshot baselines for any of the 4 critical screens: login form, workspace main view, channel view, settings page
findings.impact: Visual regression on the most-visited screens goes undetected
findings.fix: Add Playwright visual snapshot tests for login form (desktop + mobile), workspace with sidebar + channel list, and message area

findings.issue: No dark mode visual regression coverage — contrast issues in dark theme go undetected
findings.impact: Dark mode UI can degrade without detection — poor user experience for dark mode users
findings.fix: Add dark mode snapshots for all critical screens by toggling class='dark' on html element before screenshot

findings.issue: No mobile/tablet viewport snapshots — responsive layout regressions undetected
findings.impact: Mobile users may see broken layouts without automated detection
findings.fix: Add Playwright snapshot tests at 375px (mobile) and 768px (tablet) viewport widths for critical screens

findings.issue: No visual diff CI job — screenshot comparison not part of any workflow
findings.impact: Visual regression tests exist (if created) but never execute in CI
findings.fix: Add visual-diff step to E2E CI job with configurable sensitivity threshold (0.1% pixel difference)

findings.issue: No snapshot coverage for empty/loading/error states across any component or page
findings.impact: Edge case UI regressions (empty state, error display, loading skeleton) go undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for: empty workspace list, empty channel list, empty message area, loading skeleton states, 404 page, error display

findings.issue: No snapshot coverage for notification dropdown, thread panel, or file upload preview
findings.impact: Secondary UI surface regressions undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for notification dropdown (populated + empty), thread panel with replies, file upload preview

findings.issue: No Storybook installation — no component development environment for visual testing
findings.impact: Component-level visual testing requires full page renders; no isolated component snapshot capability
findings.fix: Consider adding Storybook for component-level visual regression with Chromatic

findings.issue: No screenshot baseline update mechanism documented
findings.impact: Intentional UI changes require manual baseline replacement — no workflow to approve new baselines
findings.fix: Document baseline update process: CI generates diff report, reviewer approves, new baseline committed
